verdict.rationale: Pausing a workflow for human approval is a fair question for a workflow automation tool, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has nothing on a wait, approval or human-in-the-loop step. The Webhook node, error workflows and Slack integration are adjacent features, not a documented pause-for-approval capability.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can pause a workflow to wait for human approval or input before it continues
